name: Ni Hsin Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Ni Hsin Group Berhad 的 Electric Vehicles 板块与 Chongqing Qiulong 签订 SURRON 品牌电动摩托车 CKD 组装合作协议，并与 Apex Ventures 完成 MOU，由三家子公司担任企业代理以在 Turkey 和中东推广产品；同时与 Beijing Zhongke Huizhi 及 Shenzhen United Aircraft 的 MOU 延长至 2027 年 2 月，与 Perbadanan Teknologi Hijau Melaka 的 MOU 无重大进展。
overview_en: In 2026, Ni Hsin Group Berhad's Electric Vehicles segment entered into a CKD assembly cooperation agreement with Chongqing Qiulong for SURRON brand electric motorcycles, and completed an MOU with Apex Ventures under which three subsidiaries were appointed as corporate agents to promote products in Turkey and the Middle East;

segments.name: 炊具
segments.note: 通过 Apex Ventures 的 MOU 及后续企业代理协议，推动 premium stainless steel multiply cookware 在 Turkey 和中东的推广、营销与分销。
segments.note_en: Through the MOU and subsequent corporate agent agreements with Apex Ventures, the segment is to promote, market and distribute premium stainless steel multiply cookware in Turkey and the Middle East.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Ni Hsin Corporation Sdn. Bhd. 与 Apex Ventures 签订 Corporate Agent Agreement，完成上述 MOU 的目标。
actions.text_en: Ni Hsin Corporation Sdn. Bhd. entered into a Corporate Agent Agreement with Apex Ventures, completing the objective of the said MOU.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Apex Ventures (Labuan) Limited 签订 MOU，拟在 Turkey 和中东推广、营销及分销 premium stainless steel multiply cookware 等产品。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with Apex Ventures (Labuan) Limited to promote, market and distribute premium stainless steel multiply cookware and other products in Turkey and the Middle East.

segments.note_en: Through the MOU and subsequent corporate agent agreements with Apex Ventures, the segment is to promote, market and distribute multi-ply stainless steel clad metal and stainless steel convex mirror in…

actions.text: Ever-Grow Advanced Materials Sdn. Bhd. 与 Apex Ventures 签订 Corporate Agent Agreement，完成上述 MOU 的目标。
actions.text_en: Ever-Grow Advanced Materials Sdn. Bhd. entered into a Corporate Agent Agreement with Apex Ventures, completing the objective of the said MOU.

actions.text: 与 Apex Ventures (Labuan) Limited 签订 MOU，拟在 Turkey 和中东推广、营销及分销 multi-ply stainless steel clad metal 和 stainless steel convex mirror 等产品。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with Apex Ventures (Labuan) Limited to promote, market and distribute multi-ply stainless steel clad metal and stainless steel convex mirror in Turkey and the Middle East.

segments.name: 电动车
segments.note: 与 Chongqing Qiulong 就 SURRON 品牌电动摩托车 CKD 组装签订合作协议，并与 Apex Ventures 完成企业代理协议以在 Turkey 和中东分销电动车；
segments.note_en: Entered into a CKD assembly cooperation agreement with Chongqing Qiulong for SURRON brand electric motorcycles, completed a corporate agent agreement with Apex Ventures to distribute electric vehicles…

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Ni Hsin EV Tech Sdn. Bhd. 与 Apex Ventures 签订 Corporate Agent Agreement，完成上述 MOU 的目标。
actions.text_en: Ni Hsin EV Tech Sdn. Bhd. entered into a Corporate Agent Agreement with Apex Ventures, completing the objective of the said MOU.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Apex Ventures (Labuan) Limited 签订 MOU，拟在 Turkey 和中东推广、营销及分销电动车等产品。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with Apex Ventures (Labuan) Limited to promote, market and distribute electric vehicles and other products in Turkey and the Middle East.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Perbadanan Teknologi Hijau Melaka 的 MOU 自上次公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the MOU with Perbadanan Teknologi Hijau Melaka since the last announcement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Ni Hsin EV Tech Sdn. Bhd. 与 Chongqing Qiulong 签订 Motorcycle Completely Knocked Down (CKD) Assembly Cooperation Agreement，完成上述 MOU 的目标。
actions.text_en: Ni Hsin EV Tech Sdn. Bhd. entered into a Motorcycle Completely Knocked Down (CKD) Assembly Cooperation Agreement with Chongqing Qiulong, completing the objective of the said MOU.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Beijing Zhongke Huizhi Special Information Technology Co., Ltd. 及 Shenzhen United Aircraft Technology Co., Ltd. 的 MOU 获双方同意延长至 2027 年 2 月 17 日。
actions.text_en: The MOU with Beijing Zhongke Huizhi Special Information Technology Co., Ltd. and Shenzhen United Aircraft Technology Co., Ltd. was mutually extended to 17 February 2027.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Ni Hsin EV Tech Sdn. Bhd. 与 Chongqing Qiulong Technology Co., Ltd. 签订 MOU，拟由 NHEVT 在马来西亚独家提供 SURRON 品牌电动摩托车的 CKD 组装服务。
actions.text_en: Ni Hsin EV Tech Sdn. Bhd. entered into an MOU with Chongqing Qiulong Technology Co., Ltd. for NHEVT to provide exclusive CKD assembly services in Malaysia for SURRON brand electric motorcycles.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 与 Dato' Sri Pua Tian Siong 的 Heads of Agreement 到期后不再延长。
segments.note_en: Proposed a diversification and a bonus issue of warrants; the Heads of Agreement with Dato' Sri Pua Tian Siong expired and was not extended.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 已向 Bursa Securities 提交凭单红利的额外上市申请及股东通函草稿。
actions.text_en: Proposed a diversification and a bonus issue of warrants, and submitted the additional listing application for the bonus issue of warrants and the draft circular to shareholders to Bursa Securities.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Dato' Sri Pua Tian Siong 的 Heads of Agreement 于 2025 年 12 月 31 日到期，双方因无法就拟议收购的最终条款达成一致而决定不再延长。
actions.text_en: The Heads of Agreement with Dato' Sri Pua Tian Siong expired on 31 December 2025, and the parties mutually decided not to extend it as they were unable to reach agreement on the definitive terms of the proposed acquisitions.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text_en: Proposed a diversification and a bonus issue of warrants.
